item.title: Longboat Key isn't crime-free, but it's close
item.description: Longboat Key and crime are two things that don’t really go hand-in-hand.The barrier island with an affluent populace and median age of 71 doesn’t have much of a night life scene, or a lot of outsiders that might cause trouble. It's safe to say that, in general, its residents are pretty well-behaved. Regardless, police stay busy. item.description: Manatee County is less than 100 days away from hosting its first Senior PGA Championship, which will be held at The Concession Golf Club from April 16-19.The county committed $4.5 million from its tourism tax revenue to bring the event to East County over the next three years — $1.5 million per year. item.title: Longboat Key water main break cuts north-end service
item.description: Water service on the north end of Longboat Key will be interrupted until evening as town workers repair a pipe break near Broadway Street and Gulf of Mexico Drive.The town said customers on the west side of GMD in the half-mile from Broadway Street to Reclinata Drive are affected.A contractor broke the water main, the town said.For questions or further assistance, the town asks that customers contact Public Works at 941-316-1988.

item.description: When it came to safety on a bicycle, Village Idiots Cycling Club President Dawn Zielinski said no one stood out more than Patrick Franklin Sr."He was one of my leaders, and he was not afraid to tell people they weren't following the rules," Zielinski said.
